basis: Chloroplast beta-carbonic anhydrase; Kim 2021 curated mesophyll marker (DS3) and top gene of Nobori 2025 base mesophyll clusters (0.91 vs 0.43: weak specificity, ambient RNA). C4 grasses use a cytosolic mesophyll CA. Xia 2022: rank 2-3 in both palisade and upper-epidermis lists, i.e. an adaxial photosynthesis gradient.

Rubisco small subunit; highest in mesophyll clusters (Lee 2025 30d c6 z1.2; Nobori 2025 clusters 1,2,20) but ambient and present everywhere: use specificity, not presence. Marks bundle sheath in C4. Xia 2022 Stereo-seq mesophyll 0.96 vs 0.84 (ambient).

Mesophyll-secreted peptide promoting stomatal development (Sugano et al. 2010 Nature); promoter reporter in mesophyll (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c). Young leaves; equally high in the G1-S cycling class, so not specific vs dividing mesophyll precursors.

Light-harvesting complex protein; curated mesophyll marker in Kim 2021 (DS3) and in Tenorio Berrio 2025 and Lee 2025 mesophyll DE, but photosynthesis gene, ambient, and 1.1x specificity (Tenorio portal). Kept low despite three-study agreement because specificity is poor.
LHCII subunit; promoter reporter in mesophyll (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S17) but only 1.2x enriched over G1-S cells.

IQ-domain protein; IQD22pro:GUS-mCit is palisade-specific in leaf cross-sections and defines the sorted palisade population (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 1C; FACS +1.98), but is also in petiole and trichome-base cells, poorly captured in scRNA, not specific in Lee 2025 nuclei and absent from the Xia 2022 Stereo-seq palisade list. Raised low->medium on the direct reporter evidence. Score only inside a Mesophyll call.
Hydroxyproline-rich glycoprotein; weak palisade-specific reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 1F, S3A); FACS +1.75. Score only within Mesophyll.
TAS3 tasiRNA (TASIR-ARF) locus of adaxial identity; weak palisade reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S3B); FACS +1.94. Non-coding: not in UniProt, may be absent from count matrices.
Squalene epoxidase; reporter in palisade plus lowermost spongy cells (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 1G); FACS +1.65.

Xyloglucan endotransglucosylase; reporter in palisade and epidermis, strongest adaxial (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 1H); FACS +2.99, but an epidermis gene in their scRNA (cl0). Shared with epidermis.

Sucrose-phosphate synthase; reporter mostly palisade (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C; cl4 0.50 vs 0.19); Xia 2022 Stereo-seq palisade rank 77/253 (also upper-epidermis rank 95: adaxial gradient). Medium by two-study agreement; score only within Mesophyll.

Chloroplast DnaJ protein; reporter mostly palisade (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C; cl3 0.50 vs 0.13); Xia 2022 Stereo-seq palisade rank 37/253 (also upper-epidermis rank 27: adaxial gradient). Medium by two-study agreement; score only within Mesophyll.

Rubredoxin-family chloroplast protein; reporter mostly palisade (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C; cl4 0.70 vs 0.34); marginal in Xia 2022 palisade list (rank 247/253). Photosynthesis gene, weak.

Ferulate 5-hydroxylase; palisade-enriched (FACS +1.0) and palisade-driven FAH1 rescues fah1 sinapoylmalate (UV protection) (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 6); also lignin synthesis in vasculature.
Sinapate glucosyltransferase; top palisade FACS gene (+4.10) but its reporter is brightest in epidermis near the midvein (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S3J). Conflicting; weak.

Cystine lyase; reporter in lower spongy mesophyll and bundle sheath and depleted in sorted palisade (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 1J, S4C; FACS -5.94); spongy rank 4 but also lower-epidermis rank 10 in Xia 2022 Stereo-seq; abaxial gradient in Tenorio Berrio 2025, used for Lee 2025 30d c6. Raised low->medium (Procko reporter + Xia position). Abaxial-domain gene, not spongy-specific: score only inside Mesophyll. JA-inducible (CORONATINE INDUCED 3): wound/JA state confound.

FIL/YAB1 YABBY TF specifying abaxial cell fate in all layers (Siegfried et al. 1999 Development); palisade-depleted in Procko 2022 FACS (-5.90), spongy rank 22 and lower-epidermis rank 27 in Xia 2022 Stereo-seq, weak Kim 2021 spongy marker (0.28 vs 0.07). Raised low->medium (Procko, Xia). Abaxial-domain gene, primordium-stage strongest: score only inside Mesophyll.

KANADI1 GARP TF specifying abaxial identity (Kerstetter et al. 2001 Nature); palisade-depleted in Procko 2022 FACS (-5.56); spongy rank 61 and lower-epidermis rank 61 in Xia 2022 Stereo-seq. Abaxial-domain gene: score only inside Mesophyll.

YABBY abaxial-identity TF; reporter in abaxial epidermis and spongy mesophyll (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S4B; FACS -4.02); spongy rank 54, lower-epidermis rank 135 in Xia 2022. Abaxial-domain gene: score only inside Mesophyll.

YABBY abaxial-identity TF; palisade-depleted in Procko 2022 FACS (-6.16, no reporter); spongy rank 43, lower-epidermis rank 45 in Xia 2022 Stereo-seq. Medium by two-study agreement. Abaxial-domain gene: score only inside Mesophyll.
GRAS TF expressed in bundle sheath that specifies BS fate with SCR/SHR (Cui et al. 2014 PNAS); enriched in Kim 2021 BS cluster C4 (0.42 vs 0.03). Not reported in the other three datasets.

Low-affinity sulfate transporter; promoter-GUS in BS and phloem (Takahashi et al. 2000 Plant J); BS cluster marker in Kim 2021 (C4 0.67 vs 0.02) and Tenorio Berrio 2025 (2.1x). Agreement across two datasets. Third study: Procko 2022 bundle sheath cl5 (0.31 vs 0.03) and top palisade-depleted FACS gene (-6.38). Raised medium->high.

Aliphatic glucosinolate P450; promoter reporter in bundle sheath (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c), 4.4x enriched in BS label. Xia 2022 merged vascular class (BS not resolved there); not counted as a raise.

Methionine chain-elongation aminotransferase of aliphatic glucosinolate synthesis, vascular promoter-GUS (Schuster et al. 2006 Plant Cell). Top DE of the BS/PP glucosinolate clusters in Lee 2025 (21d c5, 30d c3) and Nobori 2025 cluster 10 (0.51 vs 0.03). BS vs PP not resolved in either. Xia 2022 merged vascular class (BS not resolved there); not counted as a raise.

Methylthioalkylmalate synthase of aliphatic glucosinolate synthesis; promoter reporter in bundle sheath (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S4F; FACS -5.14; scRNA cl5/6/7), DE in Lee 2025 21d c5/30d c3 and Nobori 2025 cluster 10 (0.78 vs 0.06); Xia 2022 merged vascular class (0.21 vs 0.04). Raised medium->high: the BS assignment is now reporter-validated.

Aliphatic glucosinolate P450, vascular promoter-GUS (Reintanz et al. 2001 Plant Cell); Nobori 2025 cluster 10 (0.54 vs 0.04) only. Procko 2022 reporter in veins plus weak BS (Fig S4H; cl7 0.47 vs 0.05) and Xia 2022 vascular class (0.145 vs 0.031). Raised low->medium; vein-wide rather than BS-specific.
Aliphatic glucosinolate MYB regulator (Gigolashvili et al. 2008); DE in the glucosinolate clusters of Lee 2025 (21d c5, 30d c3); paralog MYB28 marks Nobori 2025 cluster 10. Inferred BS/PP.
Aliphatic glucosinolate MYB regulator (Gigolashvili et al. 2007 Plant J); Nobori 2025 cluster 10 (0.32 vs 0.05). Inferred BS/PP.
Threonine aldolase; bundle sheath promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 1K); palisade-depleted FACS -6.06; BS cl5 0.38 vs 0.03.
ACC oxidase 3; bundle sheath reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S4M, 3C); FACS -6.71; BS cl5 0.42 vs 0.02.
Proline-rich extensin-like protein; reporter in BS and/or veins (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C); cl5 0.45 vs 0.02.

Low-affinity sulfate transporter; promoter-GUS in leaf xylem parenchyma and phloem (Takahashi et al. 2000 Plant J); Kim 2021 XP subcluster C4.1 (0.83 vs 0.18). Xia 2022 merged vascular class only; not counted as a raise.
Amino acid permease expressed in xylem parenchyma (Okumoto et al. 2002 JBC); broad within Kim 2021 C4 (BS+XP; 0.70 vs 0.035). Xia 2022 merged vascular class only; not counted as a raise.

Clade III SWEET exporting sucrose from phloem parenchyma (Chen et al. 2012 Science); PP reporter in Kim 2021 (Fig 5P); PP cluster in Nobori 2025 (c14 0.54 vs 0.03). In Lee 2025 it is DE in the glucosinolate BS/PP cluster (21d c5). Procko 2022 PP cl6 (0.94 vs 0.05) with a vein reporter; Xia 2022 vascular class (0.12 vs 0.07) but spills into abaxial cells.

Clade III SWEET partner of SWEET11 in PP sucrose efflux (Chen et al. 2012 Science); 8x PP-specific in Tenorio Berrio 2025, Nobori 2025 c14 (0.38 vs 0.01), Kim 2021 C10.2. Procko 2022 PP cl6 (0.70 vs 0.02).
bZIP TF; PP-specific promoter reporter in two independent studies (Kim 2021 Fig 6C-D; Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S16, 5.3x). bzip9 mutant has no phenotype.
Clade III sucrose SWEET; pSWEET13:SWEET13-YFP in PP (Kim 2021 Fig 5Q), C10.2 0.49 vs 0.04. Lower expression than SWEET11/12 in wild type.

Universal-stress-protein family; PP promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c, S17), 3.9x. Second study: Procko 2022 PP cl6 (1.00 vs 0.09) with a vein reporter. Raised medium->high. Xia 2022 vascular class only weakly (0.15 vs 0.10).

WAT1-related amino acid exporter; PP subcluster C10.2 (0.51 vs 0.035) in Kim 2021, no reporter. Also Guo 2025 (10.1016/j.cell.2025.03.024): Guo PP DE in cauline c9 (0.53/0.01), S3 c10 (0.49/0.01), S4 c10 (0.45/0.01), S6 c10 (0.77/0.03); umamit20 mutant keeps more chlorophyll at S5 (68.5% vs 51% of S3 in Col-0; Table S2-10c, n=4, no test given). Second independent study: suggest raising low to medium.

Companion-cell sucrose/H+ symporter for apoplastic loading (Truernit & Sauer 1995; Stadler & Sauer 1996). CC cluster marker in Lee 2025 (21d c8, 30d c7), Nobori 2025 (c6 0.41 vs 0.03) and Tenorio Berrio 2025 (3.2x). Kim 2021 lists it under epidermis C13, not C15. Procko 2022 CC cl9 (0.92 vs 0.05); weak in Xia 2022 vascular class (0.125 vs 0.092).
Phloem-mobile HMA protein expressed in companion cells (Tian et al. 2010 Plant Cell); CC cluster DE in Lee 2025 (21d c8, 30d c7) and top Nobori 2025 c6 marker (0.67 vs 0.02).

Phloem lectin of companion cells (Dinant et al. 2003 Plant Physiol); CC promoter reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025 (Fig 3c, 3.8x); CC cluster in Kim 2021 (0.99 vs 0.035) and Nobori 2025 c6. Xia 2022 merged vascular class only (0.17 vs 0.08); not counted.
ER protein exporting FT from companion cells to sieve elements (Liu et al. 2012 PLoS Biol); CC cluster C15 in Kim 2021 (0.37 vs 0.002) and Nobori 2025 ED Fig 3d.
Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase, CC promoter-GUS (DeWitt & Sussman 1995 Plant Cell); Kim 2021 C15 (0.89 vs 0.008); Tenorio Berrio 2025 CC 1.5x over SE (shared with sieve elements).

MYB-related TF required for phloem (SE and CC) identity (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); CC cluster marker in Kim 2021 (0.80 vs 0.008) and Lee 2025 (21d c8 z1.5, 30d c7). Skill table lists it as Phloem (any). Procko 2022 CC cl9 (0.51 vs 0.006) and its S-phase cl13 (0.29), consistent with dividing phloem precursors.
Phloem-associated protein; CC promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S17), 23x.
Monothiol glutaredoxin; CC promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S17), 13.5x.

Amino acid permease of phloem (Zhang et al. 2010 Plant Physiol); Kim 2021 C15 (0.42 vs 0.007). Xia 2022 merged vascular class only; not counted as a raise. Also Guo 2025 (10.1016/j.cell.2025.03.024): Amino acid permease 2: phloem promoter-GUS (Hirner et al. 1998 Plant J; cited by Guo Table S1-3); aap2 mutants alter xylem-to-phloem amino acid transfer (Zhang et al. 2010 Plant Physiol). Guo DE in CC clusters S4 c9 (0.41/0.04), S6 c9 (0.28/0.01), root D6 c12 (0.96/0.02), flowers. The fruit table files it as Phloem.
Senescence-associated and QQS-related protein; vein promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell); CC cl9 0.83 vs 0.055.

Forms sieve-element occlusion filaments (Froelich et al. 2011 Plant Cell); 33x SE-specific in Tenorio Berrio 2025 protoplasts. Developing SEs only; mature SEs enucleate, so expect none in nuclei data.
Fasciclin-like AGP of secondary-wall cells (MacMillan et al. 2010 Plant J); xylem promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c, S17), 34x.
Germin-like protein; xylem promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S17), 21x.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (irx1); DE in Lee 2025 21d c17 (differentiating xylem + procambium). Also fibers.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (irx5); DE in Lee 2025 21d c17. Also fibers.
Xylem cysteine protease of tracheary-element PCD (Avci et al. 2008); Lee 2025 21d c17 (z1.1). Also DE in the 21d c7 doublet-like cluster.
Thermospermine synthase in xylem vessel precursors (Muniz et al. 2008 Development); Kim 2021 curated xylem marker, DE in C10 (0.13 vs 0.005), not C4 as the paper states.

HD-ZIP III TF of (pre)procambium and xylem precursors (Baima et al. 1995; Scarpella et al. 2004); Lee 2025 21d c17, highest in Tenorio Berrio 2025 Xylem label (6x, above Cambium), DE only in Kim 2021 C18. Marks xylem precursors as much as procambium.
TDIF receptor of procambium/cambium (Fisher & Turner 2007 Curr Biol); Tenorio Berrio 2025 Xylem 2.2x > Cambium; not DE in Kim 2021.
Alpha-expansin; Tenorio Berrio 2025 "cambium" promoter reporter (Fig 3c) but higher in their Xylem label (1.6x). Weak.

HD-ZIP IV TF required for L1 identity (Lu et al. 1996; Abe et al. 2003); epidermis DE in Kim 2021 C13 (0.54 vs 0.001) and Lee 2025 epidermal clusters. Pan-epidermal incl. guard and trichome lineages. Procko 2022 pavement cl0 (0.25 vs 0.04).

Epidermis-specific VLCFA elongase for cuticle; fdh organ fusion (Yephremov et al. 1999; Pruitt et al. 2000). Epidermis marker in Nobori 2025 (c0 0.66 vs 0.09, epidermis-specific ACR) and Lee 2025 (30d c1, c4, c12).

Cuticular-wax VLCFA elongase expressed in epidermis (Millar et al. 1999; Hooker et al. 2002); Kim 2021 C13 (0.97 vs 0.009) and Nobori 2025 c19 (0.58 vs 0.08). Procko 2022 pavement cl0 (0.75 vs 0.14); Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (Fig 3A, 0.22 vs 0.06).

L1-specific protodermal gene (Abe et al. 1999); epidermis reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025 (Fig 3c; highest in meristemoids, then pavement) and DE in Lee 2025 epidermal/trichome clusters. Highest in young epidermis.
GDSL lipase; epidermis promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S16). Second study: Xia 2022 Stereo-seq pooled epidermis (0.14 vs 0.03). Raised medium->high.

Lipid transfer protein with epidermal promoter-GUS (Thoma et al. 1994 Plant Physiol); Nobori 2025 c19 (0.63 vs 0.13). Large gene family. Xia 2022 Stereo-seq pooled epidermis (0.30 vs 0.09). Raised medium->high.
Wax VLCFA elongation (CER2-like; Pascal et al. 2013); epidermis DE in Nobori 2025 c0 (0.40 vs 0.06) and Lee 2025 30d c1.
Lipid transfer protein; epidermis DE in Nobori 2025 (c0 0.90 vs 0.16) and Lee 2025 30d c1. Uncharacterized function.

DUF538 protein; Kim 2021 curated epidermis marker (C13 0.99 vs 0.026), no validation. Also Procko 2022 pavement cl0 (0.93 vs 0.21) and Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (0.26 vs 0.07). Raised low->medium (three studies, expression only).
MLP-like protein; top Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis gene (0.49 vs 0.15), no validation.
Lipid transfer protein; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (0.35 vs 0.11). Large gene family.
Proline-rich cell-wall protein; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (0.13 vs 0.03).
VLCFA condensing enzyme; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (0.13 vs 0.03).
VLCFA condensing enzyme of cuticular wax; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (0.12 vs 0.03).
Glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq epidermis (0.11 vs 0.03), no validation.
Pectate lyase-like (PAVEMENT CELL-RESTRICTED EXPRESSION; UniProt PLL22); pavement promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c, S17) but only 1.6x over meristemoids.
Glycine-rich protein; epidermis promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C); top of the stress/senescing pavement cl8 (0.92 vs 0.09). Pan-pavement, side not resolved.
Acid phosphatase-like; epidermis reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell); pavement cl0 0.33 vs 0.05.

Phytochrome kinase substrate 3; adaxial-epidermis DEG in Xia 2022 Stereo-seq (upper-epidermis rank 214/411, absent from the palisade list) and Lee 2025 30d c4 (0.36 vs 0.03). Correction: not found as an adaxial gene in Procko 2022 tables (only DE in unassigned stress cl16, 0.39 vs 0.05), so the earlier Procko attribution (via Lee 2025) is dropped. Weak Xia rank, so kept medium. Use only within Epidermis.
Wax alkane-forming aldehyde decarbonylase; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq upper-epidermis rank 84, not in palisade or lower-epidermis lists. Cuticular-wax gene, likely pan-epidermal elsewhere.
Wax alkane-forming CER1 partner; Xia 2022 Stereo-seq upper-epidermis rank 300 (Fig 3D). Cuticular-wax gene, likely pan-epidermal elsewhere.

MATE transporter; abaxial-epidermis DEG in Xia 2022 Stereo-seq (lower-epidermis rank 112, absent from the spongy list) and Lee 2025 21d c12/30d c12. Raised medium->high (Xia position + Lee cluster). Correction: Procko 2022 has it only as weakly palisade-depleted in FACS (S2 -1.23), not as an epidermis gene; the earlier Procko attribution is dropped. Also in Lee 30d mesophyll c5. Use only within Epidermis.

KANADI1 abaxial-identity TF (Kerstetter et al. 2001 Nature); Xia 2022 Stereo-seq lower-epidermis rank 61. Not epidermis-specific (also spongy mesophyll) and strongest in primordia: use only within Epidermis.

FIL/YAB1 abaxial-identity YABBY TF (Siegfried et al. 1999 Development); Xia 2022 Stereo-seq lower-epidermis rank 27. Not epidermis-specific (also spongy) and strongest in primordia: use only within Epidermis.
Jacalin-related lectin; Procko 2022 epidermal subcluster gene with a reporter in lower epidermis at the midvein and margin only (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S7).
ER-body beta-glucosidase; reporter in lower epidermis at midvein and margin (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S7; called LEB there); cl16 0.37 vs 0.01.

Plant defensin; reporter in patches of abaxial epidermis (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell); marks the JA-defense cl10 (0.74 vs 0.06), so a JA state confound. Kept low (characterization table has medium).

bHLH TF for GMC-to-guard-cell transition (Ohashi-Ito & Bergmann 2006 Plant Cell); guard cluster in Lee 2025 (21d c15 z4.6; 30d c14 0.71 vs 0.01), Kim 2021 C16 (0.955 vs 0.001), Tenorio Berrio 2025. Also specifies myrosin idioblasts (second-highest there). Procko 2022 guard cl12 (0.59 vs 0.008) and myrosin cl15 (0.76); Xia 2022 Stereo-seq guard cells (Fig S4A).
Guard-cell MYB controlling stomatal movement, guard-cell GUS (Cominelli et al. 2005 Curr Biol); 20x guard-specific in Tenorio Berrio 2025. Kim 2021 has it in epidermis C13 (guard admixture).
Glycine-rich protein; guard-cell promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c, S16), 45x.

Guard-cell inward K+ channel (Nakamura et al. 1995); canonical guard marker. Tenorio Berrio 2025: guard 4.8x. Note: DE in companion-cell clusters in Kim 2021 (C15), Lee 2025 (21d c8, 30d c7) and Guo 2025 (S6 c9 0.63 vs 0.01), not in their guard clusters; do not read KAT1 alone as guard identity in a phloem-like cluster.

Guard-cell-preferential MAPK in ABA/ROS signaling (Jammes et al. 2009 PNAS); Kim 2021 C16 (0.79 vs 0.004). Procko 2022 guard cl12 (0.62 vs 0.01) and Xia 2022 Stereo-seq guard cells (Fig 3A). Raised medium->high. Also in Procko myrosin cl15 (0.31).
Guard-cell-preferential MAPK (Jammes et al. 2009 PNAS); Kim 2021 C16 (0.49 vs 0.07).
Hexose transporter expressed in guard cells (Stadler et al. 2003 Plant J); DE in Lee 2025 21d c15. Broad in 30d.

Myrosinase abundant in guard cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J) and in myrosin idioblasts; Lee 2025 30d guard c14 (0.91), Tenorio Berrio 2025 guard 4.4 vs myrosin 6.6. Use with TGG2 absent. Procko 2022 has TGG1 in the myrosin idioblast cl15 with TGG2, confirming the shared signal.

Guard-cell DE in Lee 2025 (21d c15 z3.6, 30d c14 0.49 vs 0.01) and Kim 2021 C16; no validation. Also Guo 2025 (10.1016/j.cell.2025.03.024): Lee 2025 + Kim 2021). Guo adds a third study: guard-cell DE in cauline c10 (0.50/0.01), S1 c9 (0.71/0.01), S2 c9 (0.86/0.01), S3 c11 (0.62/0.01). Keep medium (expression tier).

ABC transporter; guard-cell DE in Lee 2025 (30d c14 0.58 vs 0.02) and Kim 2021 C16. Conflict: characterized as a root endodermis/vascular monolignol transporter (Alejandro et al. 2012); Lee Supp Table 3 lists it for seedling endodermis/vasculature. Not a spatially validated guard marker. Also Guo 2025 (10.1016/j.cell.2025.03.024): Guo guard-cell DE in cauline c10 (0.49/0.02), S1 c9 (0.76/0.02), S2 c9 (0.89/0.03), S3 c11 (0.57/0.02), early-flower c4. Third study in leaf GC; the root endodermis characterization noted in the group README still stands.

GASA-family peptide; stomata-specific promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C); guard cl12 0.99 vs 0.11. Conflict: Lee 2025 21d c2 was called guard from this gene alone and is pavement, so do not call guard on GASA9 without FAMA.
bHLH TF initiating stomatal lineage divisions (MacAlister et al. 2007 Nature); 4.7x meristemoid-specific in Tenorio Berrio 2025. Young leaves only.
bHLH TF for meristemoid-to-GMC transition (Pillitteri et al. 2007 Nature); meristemoid-highest in Tenorio Berrio 2025 (4.5x, low detection).
Receptor-like protein regulating stomatal spacing, expressed in stomatal lineage (Nadeau & Sack 2002 Science); meristemoid 2.1x over guard in Tenorio Berrio 2025.

Myrosinase of phloem-associated myrosin cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J); myrosin promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c, 29x). Top gene of the Kim 2021 "guard cell" C16 (1.0 vs 0.10), so myrosin cells merge into guard clusters. Procko 2022 myrosin idioblast cl15 (0.98 vs 0.014).
Nitrile-specifier protein of glucosinolate breakdown; myrosin promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig S16), 7.4x.
R2R3 MYB initiating trichome fate (Oppenheimer et al. 1991; Kirik et al. 2005); DE in Lee 2025 21d c14. Absent from the 21d c6 "trichome" (touch state).
GL1 paralog controlling trichome branching (Kirik et al. 2005 Dev Biol); DE in Lee 2025 21d c14 and 30d c15.
R3 MYB of trichome lateral inhibition, transcribed in trichomes (Wada et al. 1997; Schellmann et al. 2002); DE in Lee 2025 21d c14 and 30d c15. Also root atrichoblasts.
HD-ZIP IV TF; trichome reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S3P); appears in the FACS palisade list, likely trichome-base contamination.
RING-H2 E3 ligase; trichome reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S3Q); FACS +2.33 (contamination).
Dirigent protein; hydathode promoter reporter (Tenorio Berrio 2025 Fig 3c, S18), 73x. Second study: Procko 2022 hydathode cl14 (0.93 vs 0.004). Raised medium->high.
Purine permease with hydathode promoter-GUS (Burkle et al. 2003 Plant J); 5.7x hydathode-specific in Tenorio Berrio 2025. Conflict: DE in Kim 2021 epidermis C13, not their hydathode C17.
Class IV chitinase; Kim 2021 hydathode marker (C17 0.37 vs 0.014), only support for that weak cluster.
Ole e 1-like protein; hydathode promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig 3C); hydathode cl14 0.70 vs 0.03.
Ole e 1-like protein; hydathode promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell); cl14 0.72 vs 0.02.
LTP-like protein; hydathode promoter reporter (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell); cl14 0.68 vs 0.07.
Unknown protein; hydathode reporter, with veins in some plants (Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell, Fig S3M); cl14 0.94 vs 0.16.
Replication clamp, S phase; S-phase/endocycle C14 in Kim 2021 and Lee 2025 dividing clusters. Not specific in Tenorio Berrio 2025 (1.0x).
Replication-dependent histone H2A; top marker of the Nobori 2025 "Unknown" cluster 16 (0.48 vs 0.01), an S-phase state.
Histone H2A.6 (RAT5); Tenorio Berrio 2025 G1-S/meristemoid marker (Fig 2h). Highest in meristemoids, 2.6x over G1-S.
Ribonucleotide reductase large subunit (dNTP supply for replication); top of Procko 2022 cl13, an S-phase cluster mislabelled 'sieve elements' (0.31 vs 0.02).
Ribonucleotide reductase small subunit; Procko 2022 S-phase cl13 (0.34 vs 0.04).
Cytokinesis syntaxin (Lukowitz et al. 1996 Cell); G2/M marker in Lee 2025 (21d c10/c16, 30d c13) and Tenorio Berrio 2025 G2-M (4.8x).
Mitotic B-type cyclin; Lee 2025 21d c16 and Tenorio Berrio 2025 G2-M (2.3x, low detection).
Plant-specific G2/M CDK; Lee 2025 21d c10 and 30d c13; Tenorio Berrio 2025 meristemoid/G2-M.
Cytokinesis kinesin activating NPK1 (Nishihama et al. 2002 Cell); Tenorio Berrio 2025 G2-M marker (3.9x).
APC/C activator of mitosis (Kevei et al. 2011 Plant Physiol); Lee 2025 30d c13 (0.19 vs 0.01).

Glycine-rich protein of vein patterning (DEFECTIVELY ORGANIZED TRIBUTARIES 1); vein reporter and mixed vascular cl7 (0.30 vs 0.016) in Procko et al. 2022 Plant Cell; top gene of the merged Xia 2022 Stereo-seq vascular class (0.11 vs 0.02). Coarse vascular label only.
